the quantitative examination of the ciliary elements in bronchial mucose in suspicion of cilia dyskinesia.
the ultrastructure of the bronchial mucous membrane in children with the clinical diagnosis of Kartagener's or immotile ciliary syndrome.

the quantitative changes of the ciliaris elements are the most reliable criteria for the diagnosis of ciliary dysfunctions.
the immotile ciliary syndrome is a heterogeneous disease.
the quantitative examination of ciliaris components of bronchial epithelium by electron microscopically is suitable for the diagnosis of primary or secondary ciliopathy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the primary and secondary ciliary defects could be differentiated with the help of the electron microscopic examination of bronchial ciliaris.
the ciliary dyskinetic syndrome is a complex of primary and secondary ciliary dyskinetis.
in the Kartagener's Syndrome the primary ciliary changes are present, and in other ciliary dyskineas the secondary changes are presented.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ciliary defects are the primary and secondary changes of the ciliaris structure.
the ultrastructural examination of ciliaris in bronchial mucosal biopsies may be used as a diagnostic method for the ciliary dyskinetic syndromes.
